# Supplied angular tiger

Based on the user-supplied image. Transparent background extracted using the built-in image editing tool; eye movement is overlaid by the website.

## Edit prompt

Use case: background-extraction. Edit only the attached tiger image. Remove the pure white background outside the tiger, replacing it with real transparent alpha. Preserve this exact angular painted tiger illustration, its orange/gold/purple colors, texture, expression, closed eyelids, pupils, every stripe and fine dark whisker, and its scale and position. Keep the same square framing: torso cut off exactly at the bottom edge, body touching left edge near the bottom, generous transparent area above the head. Preserve the white and cream regions INSIDE the animal. Do not redesign, recolor, restyle, add a shadow, add outlines, change the eyes, or add any text. This is a precise background removal only.
